entries.en: Moxia believes milkroot is best used in moderation.
entries.fr: Moxia a besoin de votre aide.
entries.ja: シルフの仮宿のモキシアは、冒険者の力を借りたいようだ。
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Moxia fears that excessive consumption of milkroot by the sylphs of the Sylphlands is contributing to their descent into madness. Get at the root of the problem by chopping down milkroot clusters or milkroot saplings, and harvest six bundles of fresh milkroot to prevent the substance from falling into the hands of those who would misuse it.

entries.en: Moxia thanks you profusely for the milkroot, praising its exceptional freshness while giving nary a mention of her original aim in sending you to harvest it. For all her talk of moderation, it is evident that Moxia rather enjoys the root herself. Though it may not be the adventurer's place to begrudge the beleaguered sylph the occasional moment of levity, one can only hope that she knows when to say when.
entries.fr: Moxia est très content d'avoir fait d'une pierre deux coups grâce à vous : sa réserve de tuberculaits a grossi aux dépens de celle des Dénaturés. Il ne manquera pas de faire encore appel à vous à l'avenir.
entries.ja: モキシアに依頼品を渡した。モキシアは、一石二鳥の解決法にご満悦な様子で、冒険者に礼を言った。またの機会に協力しよう。

entries.en: This one enjoys milkroot as much as any one. But naughty ones...some naughty ones enjoy milkroot a little too much. Turns naughty ones' minds to muck.

Écoute, écoute, les Dénaturés font les malins,
ils se rient de nous, les gredins.

entries.en: Those ones forget once being like these ones, and become naughtier and naughtier. These ones' words no longer reach naughty ones.
entries.fr:
Ils se gavent de tuberculait de haute qualité,
à tel point qu'ils sont toujours éméchés,
et nos farces ne peuvent plus les ennuyer !
entries.ja:
あいつら、「ミルクルート」をわんさか使ってるせいで、
わたぴらがいくらイタズラしても
へっちゃらなのでふっち。
